item.title: Super Nt+ et Mega Sg+ : Analogue relance ses consoles Super Nintendo et Mega Drive, sans fil cette fois
item.description: Analogue annonce la Super Nt+ et la Mega Sg+, deux consoles FPGA vendues 219,99 dollars (environ 195 euros hors taxes) pour rejouer aux cartouches Super Nintendo et Mega Drive. Les modèles d'origine avaient quitté le catalogue en 2022.

item.title: Behold, Intel plans a 480GB GPU, a video card with more memory than the average laptop SSD has storage — but of course it's for AI, and curiously, it will use LPPDR5X, not even GDDR7
item.description: The Intel 480GB GPU combines 1.5TB/s bandwidth, 1.3 petaflops FP8 performance, and 350W power consumption, although pricing and availability remain undisclosed.

item.title: Mister Organ is one of the most unsettling documentaries I’ve ever seen
item.description: Mister Organ doesn't reach the level of societal horror of The Act of Killing or the creepypasta-meets-true-crime gruesomeness of Beware the Slenderman, but there's something deeply unsettling about Michael Organ and his intimate campaign of terror against everyone who enters his life. Mister Organ is a documentary by David Farrier, an Auckland, New Zealand journalist. […]...

item.title: Anthropic is pitching Congress its own AI safety bill, report says
item.description: Anthropic has privately pitched lawmakers a draft AI safety bill that would narrow when federal officials can stop a model’s release and override some state AI rules.

item.title: Everyone’s watching the Elizabeth Holmes documentary ‘You Can See Everything’
item.description: "You Can See Everything" is having the second biggest opening weekend ever for a documentary film.

item.title: What is the star button for on your Roku remote?
item.description: While the Roku remote doesn't have confusing colors or weird symbols, the star button can confuse some folks at first.
